keyFindings.description: Round 1 finding 2 is only partly fixed. refuseBTW (1301-1306) releases the claim and awaits postDispatchReply before recording the event id. A reply that throws (non-2xx, network) skips the record; a sweep during the in-flight POST sees the frame neither pending nor recorded; and a refusal while shutting down records nothing, because the host's sessionID() answers undefined once shuttingDown is set, so recordDelivered returns at bind(). Each case replays the refused BTW as a steering card. Record before releasing, in a form that persists during shutdown; add tests for a failing reply and for the shutdown refusal followed by a resume.

Round 1 finding 5 is only partly fixed. receivedAt (1229, and claude-envoy channel-forwarder.ts 150) is taken when deliver starts, not when the frame arrived, so a frame queued behind a slow delivery while its subject's cursor starts (a new follow, a stream recreation) is stamped after the cursor start; if it then fails, liveFailed leaves it to a sweep that never reads it. Deep-review reproduced this in a scratch copy (expected one card or notice, received 0).

The PR body's Contract change census states three things the code does not do. (a) Rollout says a serve-port session 'no longer has it stored, so the listener's interest fan-out no longer matches it', but the guard filters only the incoming topics and Registry.Upsert merges them into the stored row (kv.go mergeForUpsert, store.Merge), so a row stored before the upgrade keeps fanning out exception-lane and controller-lane messages through registry.Match. (b) 'pi-envoy and claude-envoy now leave it out of what they register' holds only for agent subjects (coversAnotherAgentSubject). (c) 'both close the cross-session read' overstates: replay of another session's agent subject by its real id still works under the listener's existing trust model. Filter the stored row on upsert (recommended, makes (a) true) and correct (b) and (c).

The structural item is half done: sendCard returns a boolean and hands settle and release back to every caller (showReplayCard envoy.ts 1081-1088, live card 1353-1360, text and typed turns 1392-1414 with their identity === undefined branches and taken()). Make sendCard settle when nothing waits and release on a throw, returning the outcome, and let awaitTurn settle at once without an identity, so no caller repeats the claim protocol.

Line 905 cites bus.CoversAnotherAgentSubject, which no longer exists (bus.ReachesPrivateStreamSubject and bus.SharedStreamTopic); replay-host-policy.test.ts:37 says 'as the listener does'. The host filter covers only agent subjects, so a followed exception lane or notifications.legion topic is registered and warned about on every heartbeat.

Lines 232-238 say a withdrawn pi.sendUserMessage turn is released for a sweep; in production the aborted run's agent_end calls textTurnsEnded() (envoy.ts 3247), which records it shown first, and unwritten-frames.test.ts 261-292 skips that call. Correct the comment and the test, or have handBackWithdrawn take text turns too.
Merge 5e45356e rewrote go.work.sum (4 entries added or removed) though no go.mod changed; the same churn was reverted in ac39a68. Restore main's copy.
